description:
FILED s521a (Opus 5.5, 2026-10-18) from #3362's acceptance run (scratch/s521a/comp1.log, one-file companion on b3b78946).

#3362 (s520 ruling (1) = (a)) made `B::CV::CvFLAGS` answer CVf_ANON / CVf_LVALUE / CVf_METHOD, so op/stash.t's CvFLAGS rows (79 / 91 / 103) PASS now -- but the file then reaches line 143:

    $gv = B::svref_2object($sub)->GV;
    is $gv->STASH->NAME, '__ANON__',
     'CV anonymised when its stash is detached becomes __ANON__::__ANON__';

UNGUARDED (no eval).  lib/B.pm's `B::GV::STASH` for a sub with no recorded name dies "B::GV::STASH of an anonymous sub is not supported by PCL (the package an anonymous sub was compiled in is not recorded ...)" (#3281's designed die) and that ABORTS the file.  Measured (perl / C before / C after):
  op/stash.t   P 54/1   C 20/7 (main since #3281)  ->  C 31/12 (s521a)   [pre-#3281 snapshot 48/7: the B block was SKIPPED because `require B` failed]
  uni/stash.t  P 48/1   C 17/6                     ->  C 28/11            [snapshot 43/6]
The 5 + 5 extra fails are honest: `eval { $gv->STASH->NAME }` rows (81 / 93 "...but leaves stash intact" expect "one" / "two"; 105 "...and an __ANON__ stash") answer undef because the die is trapped.

The question (rule 12's value-consumed boundary, as #3362's was): perl's answer for an anonymous sub's GV->STASH is the COMPILING package ("main" for `sub {}` in main), and "__ANON__" once that stash was deleted.  PCL records neither.  Shapes:
  (a) record the compiling package of an anonymous sub (p-sub / the anon lambda already knows *package* at definition -- a runtime fact like builtin::sub_name; then GV->STASH answers it, and a deleted stash could answer __ANON__ if stash deletion is tracked) -- real work, the right answer;
  (b) answer "__ANON__" for every anonymous sub's GV->STASH (a guess: wrong for ordinary anon subs, where perl says the package) -- NOT recommended;
  (c) keep the die (status quo after #3362): op/stash.t 31/12, uni/stash.t 28/11, the companion baselines edited to those numbers citing this task.
s521a shipped (c) as the interim and edited the companion rows citing #3362 + this task.

=== RULED (Fable, s521, 2026-10-18 18:0x; DECIDED ## s521) === (a): record the package an anonymous sub was compiled in and answer it from B::GV::STASH->NAME (and CvSTASH) -- the emitter knows the package in force at every `sub {...}` site, and p-sub already records a defining NAME (builtin::sub_name, #3281) and a HOME package for named subs (%p-sub-name-home, s519b): extend that record to anonymous subs (the site's package) rather than a second slot, rule 11.  Never (b) -- a guessed "__ANON__" is the silent-wrong family; (c) stays only until (a) lands.  BAR: op/stash.t 48/7 + uni/stash.t 43/6 or better in one-file companion runs (their rows re-edited); a guard row in Pl/t/b-shim-01.t (STASH->NAME of an anon sub compiled in package Foo = Foo, perl oracle).  Scheduled for the filler brief after s521c (with #3514, #3369, #3452, #3470, #3513).


=== DONE (s521d, Opus 5.5, 2026-10-18; commit e6c47380) === ruled (a) built.  Every `sub {...}` lambda (v2 _lower_embedded_anon + the v1 parse_block_as_function twin) is wrapped `(p-anon-sub "PKG" (lambda ...))`; the macro makes it an sb-int:named-lambda named "PKG::__ANON__", so the record IS the function's own name (zero run-time cost; a closure shares its code object's name) -- no second slot.  builtin::sub_stash (perl's CvSTASH, already the attribute record's reader) answers it via %p-sub-stash-of; a lazy `\&{"name"}` stub's GV package via the new builtin::sub_stub_package (its CvSTASH = the package current when perl made it, not recorded -> dies, rule 12).  lib/B.pm: GV->STASH / CV->STASH of an anonymous sub answer it.  Probes (pr/st1.pl: main, Foo, package-block, string eval in Bar, named, closure from Foo called in main, blessed, in a hash, nested package statement) = perl.  Side effect, perl-right: attributes::get of an unattributed anon sub now asks its package's FETCH_CODE_ATTRIBUTES (pr/at1.pl, base differed).  Guards Pl/t/b-shim-01.t (perl-compared anon main / Foo / Foo::Bar / closure / eval / stub GV), inverse FAIL on 68aeebf5; prototype-01.t 121/123/125 re-spelled (s377).  gen v2-7584, artifacts regenerated.  BAR NOT MET AS WRITTEN: 48/7 is unreachable -- that snapshot had the whole B block SKIPPED; with the block running, the detached / undefined-stash rows (`%two:: = ()`, `undef %three::`, `delete $::{"six::"}`) need stash-deletion tracking, and the bloop stub's CV->STASH + B::CV::FILE die unguarded further down.  The op/stash.t replica (pr/stb2.pl) differs from perl only on the three detached-stash rows.  Companion one-file numbers: see the s521d report.
subject: RULING WANTED: op/stash.t:143 + uni/stash.t call `$gv->STASH->NAME` UNGUARDED on the GV of an anonymised sub; lib/B.pm dies by design (the package an anonymous sub was compiled in is not recorded) and ABORTS both files after #3362 -- 31/12 and 28/11 against the pre-#3281 snapshot 48/7 and 43/6
